question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
-- Final answer: top 5 constructors by number of seasons where they had the fewest total points
WITH constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, SUM(res.points) as total_points
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.race_id = res.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name
    HAVING SUM(res.points) > 0
),
min_points_per_season AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM constructor_season_points
    GROUP BY year
),
fewest_per_season AS (
    SELECT csp.year, csp.constructor_id, csp.constructor_name, csp.total_points
    FROM constructor_season_points csp
    JOIN min_points_per_season mps ON csp.year = mps.year AND csp.total_points = mps.min_points
)
SELECT constructor_name, COUNT(*) as num_seasons_fewest
FROM fewest_per_season
GROUP BY constructor_name
ORDER BY num_seasons_fewest DESC, constructor_name ASC
LIMIT 5
